name: @pipeworx/mcp-ygoprodeck

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search Yu-Gi-Oh! trading card game (TCG) cards by name (fuzzy), card type, attribute, monster race/type, archetype, or level. Returns matching cards with names, types, descriptions, ATK/DEF, attributes, archetypes, images, and TCGplayer card prices.

name.description: Fuzzy card name match, e.g. "Dark Magician", "Blue-Eyes".

type.description: Card type, e.g. 'Effect Monster', 'Normal Monster', 'Spell Card', 'Trap Card', 'XYZ Monster'.

race.description: Monster type/race, e.g. 'Spellcaster', 'Dragon', 'Warrior'. For Spell/Trap, the property e.g. 'Continuous', 'Quick-Play'.

num.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Look up a single Yu-Gi-Oh! trading card game (TCG) card by its exact name. Returns full card details including type, description, ATK/DEF, level, attribute, archetype, banlist status, printed sets with rarities, and card prices (TCGplayer, Cardmarket, eBay, Amazon).

tools.name: random_card
tools.description: Get a random Yu-Gi-Oh! trading card game (TCG) card with full details including type, description, ATK/DEF, attribute, archetype, sets, and card prices.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ygoprodeck forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ygoprodeck pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
